title: expand_url_template: O(n*m) repeated string replacement instead of single pass
description: blob.rs lines 33-40: expand_url_template calls result.replace() once per variable, rebuilding the entire string on every iteration. For JMAP templates with 4 variables this rebuilds the string 4 times. The function name 'expand' implies template expansion; a single-pass scan that emits substituted or literal bytes as it goes is both more efficient and reflects the concept directly. Rewrite: scan template byte-by-byte, copying literals and substituting {name} tokens in one pass into a preallocated output buffer.
